response.sql: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS average_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS average_excess FROM patient_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: Patients whose ratio is undefined because either average is missing or average HCT is zero are excluded from the all-patient ratio average and cannot qualify.
